rationale: The single reported investments-at-fair-value balance is the grand total. It equals the recognized non-affiliated positions of 1228169000.0 plus the affiliated AGL EPCI I equity investment of 21275000.0. The additional 231531000.0 in extracted holdings consists of look-through positions dimensioned to the nonconsolidated subsidiary AGL EPCI I and would double count that equity investment. The grand total is 94.9% of total assets of 1316257000.0, leaving a plausible non-investment remainder of 66813000.0. The companyfacts tag therefore captured the complete recognized investment balance, not merely a non-affiliated subtotal.
